title: Read offset mutates into huge invalid value
details:
- **What happened:** Model intended to read offset 1000 but emitted `offset: 1000000000000000` plus irrelevant `pages: "1"`, after multiple earlier decimal-place offset mistakes. Expected exact range arguments copied from the planned range.
- **What the user said:** "连续搜索或尝试约 3 次无实质进展时停止"；persistent feedback already said to stop repeating invalid Read offsets.
- **Repro:** Ask model to continue reading a large source file at lines 1000–2000 after an earlier Read range failure; inspect emitted Read arguments.
- **Evidence:** `code/backend-java/src/main/java/com/ztys/dtsf/platform/service/BusinessDocumentService.java`; tool reported file has 2591 lines; session date 2026-09-11.
